value.notes: ZHVI basis; level anchored Sep 2026. Intervals from backtest APEs; widened x1.5 where projected price/income exceeds 1.5x the current ratio (income held at ACS 2023).

schools.notes: Weak-signal dimension: near-persistence by backtest verdict. ZIP-area proficiency (not attendance zones), fit on post-COVID years only.

insurance.notes: Point = FAIR Plan share of housing units. pressure_index is a scenario index (exposure + enrollment growth), not a premium forecast; read against the +29.1% FAIR filing.

crime.notes: SF: persistence of trailing 3y rate (EB/trend rejected by backtest). Oakland/Sonoma: level-only, no trend claimed, until snapshots accumulate.

disaster.notes: Scenario, not a trend forecast: hazard held at NRI v1.20; building EAL scales with projected value growth, population EAL with county population growth. Interval is a stated +/-25% exposure band, not a backtest score.

water.notes: Persistence; interval is measured CES release-to-release drift (2018 -> 2021), part methodology revision.
